title: an-honest-once-clause-is-not-a-present-claim
intention: build_inspector's charter_asserts_file_present reads any 'once <its|the|a|this> ...' clause as an honest qualification, so a charter that says its journal will exist once a voyage freezes is not read as asserting the file is there now.
why: Measured 2026-10-01 by the pre-commit reseal of commit 4a38b2ed: test_charter_asserts_file sealed red on three sleep_cycle findings although that charter honestly says its journal exists 'once a voyage freezes here'. The lived symptom: an honest charter reads red at inspection, and the next mind either rewrites a true sentence to please the sieve or learns to ignore the red.
traces_to: Law 9: the sieve reds an honest charter, so the red measures the sieve's vocabulary, not a false claim. The sieve's own docstring: a charter that honestly qualifies the absence is describing a not-yet state and passes. Measured census of 'once' qualifiers across every charter's state_and_history: once its ticket exists (2), once the seam crosses (1), once a voyage freezes (1).
how: In cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py, _HONEST_ABSENCE's three spelled 'once' alternatives (once its ticket, once the seam crosses, once a ticket) become one: \bonce (?:its|the|a|this)\b. Proved by a new tooth in cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_charter_asserts_file.py over a fixture charter saying 'once a voyage freezes here', and by test_live_corpus_is_clean going green.
falsifier: RED if: (1) a fixture charter saying 'state.json + history.json beside this charter once a voyage freezes here' yields any finding; (2) the existing false-assertion tooth (born at the carve-out) stops finding its files; (3) test_live_corpus_is_clean still reds. Horizon: the tester seal.
watchme: none, because the consumer is test_live_corpus_is_clean in cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_charter_asserts_file.py, which the pre-commit reseal reruns over the whole charter corpus
children: none, because the change is one regex in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py plus one tooth
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) The regex? r"FIRST CROSSING|\bonce (?:its|the|a|this)\b|until a ticket crosses|NONE,? and", IGNORECASE kept. (2) The tooth? test_once_a_voyage_qualifies: _make_charter(d, "state.json + history.json beside this charter once a voyage freezes here (Law 5).") must yield []; added to _main's checks before test_live_corpus_is_clean.

chart_claim.filled_by: CC chart chain (orient 99598bd915da .. validate 9cf384a72b6d, each learned)

decisions.text: STEP 1, the red tooth. In cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_charter_asserts_file.py add, after test_honest_qualification_passes: def test_once_a_voyage_qualifies(): with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d: comp = _make_charter(d, 'state.json + history.json beside this charter once a voyage freezes here (Law 5).'); result = charter_asserts_file_present({'component': 'test_component'}, comp); assert result == [], f'an honest once-clause must pass, got {result}'. Add it to _main's checks list directly after test_honest_qualification_passes (before test_live_corpus_is_clean). Run the proof: before the build the new tooth raises AssertionError naming two findings (history.json, state.json) and _main stops there — that is the recorded red.

STEP 2, the build. In cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py the _HONEST_ABSENCE pattern becomes re.compile(r"FIRST CROSSING|\bonce (?:its|the|a|this)\b|until a ticket crosses|NONE,? and", re.IGNORECASE) — the three alternatives 'once its ticket', 'once the seam crosses', 'once a ticket' are replaced by the one determiner pattern, the other three alternatives are unchanged, and charter_asserts_file_present's body does not move. Run test_charter_asserts_file.py green twice; test_false_assertion_is_caught and test_live_corpus_is_clean must both pass.

D1 measured 2026-10-01: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_charter_asserts_file.py exists; line 31 imports charter_asserts_file_present from cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector; _make_charter(d, state_and_history, create_files=None) at line 35 returns the component Path; teeth test_false_assertion_is_caught (45), test_honest_qualification_passes (55), test_present_file_passes (65), test_not_hardcoded_to_two_filenames (75), test_live_corpus_is_clean (83); _main at line 95 holds the checks list. The new tooth test_once_a_voyage_qualifies calls _make_charter(d, 'state.json + history.json beside this charter once a voyage freezes here') inside tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() and asserts charter_asserts_file_present({'component': 'test_component'}, comp) == []; it is inserted into checks directly after test_honest_qualification_passes.

D2 measured 2026-10-01: _HONEST_ABSENCE is defined at cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py lines 2434-2438 as re.compile(r"FIRST CROSSING|once its ticket|once the seam crosses|once a ticket|" r"until a ticket crosses|NONE,? and", re.IGNORECASE). The build replaces the three 'once' alternatives (once its ticket, once the seam crosses, once a ticket) with the single alternative r"\bonce (?:its|the|a|this)\b", keeping FIRST CROSSING, until a ticket crosses, NONE,? and, and re.IGNORECASE unchanged; every phrase the old pattern matched still matches.

The fixture string is exactly 'state.json + history.json beside this charter once a voyage freezes here (Law 5).' — with '(Law 5).', the sleep_cycle charter's own wording; D3's quotation without it is the same sentence truncated, and either string must pass because the match is on 'once a'. Use the D1 string.
